text_block_list.text:
A lineup of runners that could be called a 
reenactment of last year's Prix de l'Arc 
de Triomphe. Among them, <chrname> put up a brave 
fight.

A high-level battle— The fervent 
Representative Exchange Match sends a wave 
of excitement sweeping across Japan.

And expectations for the members of 
"Project L'Arc" grew immensely as well. 
The next "Representative Exchange Race" 
was at the end of June—

So that she could earn the right to 
represent Japan. So that she could become 
an Umamusume worthy of those expectations. 
She set her new goal on the Takarazuka 
Kinen.
